==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Portrayed as {{ci|LeBlanc}} in the CBLoL 2015 official wallpaper.
* His favorite skin is [[Ravenborn LeBlanc]].
* Famous for his straw hat, a common apparel in the Brazilian ''Festa Junina''.<ref>[https://twitter.com/brucerlol/status/1673103103682281472 Brucer's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* After he said he was a "professional gamer" during an interview about a totally unrelated subject for a local YouTube channel, and the footage became viral in Brazil, the community started calling him "the Neymar of Games".<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UfsF34mbjtw É O NEYMAR DOS GAMES] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Infamously known for his {{ci|Lucian}} performance against [[Jensen]]'s {{ci|Leblanc}} in his debut game in [[Worlds 2017]].
* He often refers to his gameplay as a "Weakside Midlaner".
* Is considered the idol of [[Los Grandes]] by one of its owners, '''Terron''', despite never having played directly for the team, but for the team involved in the merge who created the team, [[Team oNe eSports]].<ref>[https://twitter.com/ilhadaslendas/status/1771372729251291639 Ilha das Lendas' Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* Is a big friend of [[dyNquedo]], who he jokingly says is his "boyfriend".<ref>[https://x.com/CBOLAOgg/status/1731356415451648016 CBOLÃO's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* Nicknamed "Oreia" by [[Ilha das Lendas]] and the brazilian community, which can be roughly translated to "Big Ear".
* His '''Kings Lendas''' team name comes from his nickname "Oreia".
